    return default

    normalized['email'] = str(get_field(record, EMAIL_FIELDS, ''))
    normalized['created_date'] = str(get_field(record, DATE_FIELDS, ''))

        normalized['status'] = record['status']
    elif 'is_active' in record:
        normalized['status'] = 'active' if record['is_active'] in [True, 'true', 'true'] else 'inactive'
